No item was written. No branch was published. ``` This is a repository tracker identity collision, not evidence of a generic SDK defect or data loss. ## Exact records Both current records carry `gh:unbraind/pm-memory#15`: - [features/pm-memory-1363.toon](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-memory/blob/fef0a6d5469b7662cd48c594475d0b0d7808ae02/.agents/pm/features/pm-memory-1363.toon) - [issues/pm-memory-c3gv.toon](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-memory/blob/fef0a6d5469b7662cd48c594475d0b0d7808ae02/.agents/pm/issues/pm-memory-c3gv.toon) The feature preserves portable guidance validity; the separate issue preserves stale-merge receipt/replay safety. Both are closed and have distinct acceptance criteria and retained evidence. [PR15](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-memory/pull/15) is merged delivery evidence shared by these distinct records. Shared delivery must not be mistaken for one unique importer identity or a reason to merge/delete records. ## Expected / impact Gated issue sync can plan safely with unambiguous importer identities while both items retain their independent meaning, history, status and verified delivery references. Currently the entire scheduled import is blocked before writes. ## Preservation-first acceptance and validation - Establish which reference is true importer identity versus shared delivery provenance, using the existing supported tracker representation. Retain the delivery link on both records in non-colliding evidence; do not blindly delete provenance. - Keep both IDs, bodies, criteria, statuses, closure timestamps, comments, relationships and existing history intact. Any metadata correction must use native append-only history and a recoverable backup. - In an isolated recoverable copy, rerun the same gated dry-run import and verify the duplicate count is zero without relaxing the gate. - Prove before/after preservation of both records and history prefixes; repeat import planning to establish stable identity and no new duplicate items. - Leave implementation/provider writes to the existing owner. Evidence limits: hosted refusal plus read-only full current tracker inventory and exact record inspection. No local import reproduction or correction was executed.
